voters: 200 sampled TEST humans + all TEST bots, per split seed 0-4
tau_calibration: 0.995 quantile of P(bot) among VAL humans of the same split
selection_rationale: Among NAAF variants meeting the win rule on val mean, chosen for margin: val bot acceptance 0.708, honest 0.994 (SumUp val 0.988 / 0.998), won 5/5 val splits. q0.99 had lower bot acceptance (0.583) but sat exactly at the 1-pt honest limit and won only 4/5.
win_rule: attacker capacity per attack edge < SumUp AND honest collection rate >= SumUp - 0.01
also_reported_same_run: sumup, classifier_only@q0.995, and the other NAAF variants at q0.995 (secondary, not used for selection)
